Jasmine — thanks for the quick demo last week. Legal/compliance at Aurelia wants to lock language for the security exhibit before we sign the order form. A few specific asks we need covered in the MSA/order form: 

1) SOC 2: we need confirmation of frequency (annual SOC 2 + option for supplemental attestation). Can Redwood provide the SOC 2 report and system description under NDA?

2) Pen test / inspection rights: our security team prefers the ability to do an annual penetration test and a bounded inspection if necessary. We need to understand Redwood's stance on on-site vs remote testing, notice windows, and tooling access (temporary read-only access to logs).

3) Evidence cadence & retention: request for a runbook describing the evidence handoff cadence for production incidents and quarterly evidence samples (API logs, access logs, change logs) for six months of retention.

4) Tenant isolation & staging access: to complete our pen test scope we may need ephemeral staging access or exportable test data. Is a customer-owned staging environment possible?

Can you send proposed exhibit language or a redline? If you prefer, we can share Aurelia's template and mark changes. We need to close this ahead of procurement review next Wednesday.

Kate / Aurelia — thanks for the detailed feedback. I reviewed Jasmine's redline and Aurelia's asks. Below is our proposed compromise language (summary) to include in the security exhibit and Order Form: 

1) SOC 2 delivery: Redwood will deliver the most recent Type II SOC 2 report within 5 business days of countersignature via a secure link; if a downloadable copy is required, we will provide the report under the terms of an executed NDA. (We will not provide underlying raw evidence beyond the report and system description.)

2) Pen test & inspection: Redwood will permit one customer-initiated penetration test per 12-month period against a mutually agreed scoped environment. Testing will be conducted remotely unless otherwise agreed. Standard notice is 30 days; Redwood agrees to allow one expedited 14-day notice slot per 12-month period for critical vendor assessments. All tests must be scheduled and approved through Redwood's assurance team to protect production stability.

3) Evidence exports: Redwood will provide a documented evidence-request process with a 7-business-day target for handoff of sampled artifacts (logs, config snapshots) where technically feasible. For forensic exports that require engineering-level access, Redwood will perform the export and deliver read-only artifacts; Redwood will not provide direct console or SSH access to production systems. Retention: system logs retained for at least 180 days (6 months) unless otherwise agreed in the Order Form.

4) Staging / tenancy: Redwood supports customer-managed staging deployments. Where Redwood hosts ephemeral staging for testing, Redwood will use isolated tenancy and ephemeral credentials; Redwood will provide a staging onboarding checklist (networking, seeding guide, test keys).

I can add precise MSA clause text if you confirm these points. If Aurelia agrees we can incorporate the wording into the Order Form and attach as an exhibit.

-Jonas Weber
General Counsel (covering Contracts)
Redwood Inference
